$note: Who vendors this package's built CSS, and where. A path that does not exist on this machine is skipped, not an error, so the build works on a CI runner with no siblings. Roots resolve against this repo's parent directory unless absolute; NFCCOOL_DESIGN_CONSUMER_ROOT overrides that parent. Sync UPDATES a vendored file that is already there and never creates one: a consumer adopts the package deliberately, with --adopt, not as a side effect of someone running a build.

business_card_service.why: Django, no npm at all: the bundle is copied into staticfiles and linked from the templates. Adoption is IN PROGRESS as of 2026-09-07 and lives on the design/card-page-on-design-system branch, where both files are still untracked; main's console links its own dashboard.css and does not consume the package. Until that branch lands this entry only refreshes the copies when that branch is the one checked out.

MomentoMarks.why: Astro with a bundler, but the package cannot be installed: this repo is private on GitHub and the cell's Docker image installs from manifests alone, so a git or link: dependency breaks the production build. The full bundle is vendored (the app pages carry the archetype layer unused; it collides with nothing there), plus the two scripts. Adopted 2026-09-21 on the MomentoMarks branch design-system; until that branch lands on main this entry only refreshes the copies when that branch is the one checked out.
